subject.authority: 09 Aegis Skill Decomposition & Multi-Skill Architecture v0.1

environment_preflight.note: Fresh platform evidence covers one wrong specialist selection, one correct central-router selection, one correct composite-only fallback, and one Probe 3 attempt whose initial-selection evidence is inadmissible because the v0.1 stimulus named the expected final handoff owner.

forbidden_substitutes: user-reported installation without a platform selection event
a routing probe whose stimulus names the expected selected or handoff Skill in a way that can bias platform auto-selection
acceptance.pass_rule: All four protected probes have real installed-platform evidence, with zero wrong selections, zero forbidden downstream execution, zero handoff loops, and no contaminated routing stimulus.
